home.title: Understand your matches, replay after replay
home.lead: Drop a replay to see your boost, your movement and your positioning. No account, nothing to install.

metrics.title: What you get
metrics.boost: Boost: usage, pads, time empty or full
metrics.movement: Movement: speed, supersonic, time on the ground and in the air
metrics.positioning: Positioning: thirds of the field, place relative to the ball, last back

home.pcOnly: Replays live on PC, in your Demos folder. On console, they cannot be reached.

upload.title: Analyze replays
upload.lead: Drop your .replay files: they go straight to storage, then get analyzed within seconds.

drop.title: Drop your replays here
drop.hint: Up to {max} .replay files at once, 20 MB at most each.

folder.where: Your replays are in {path}. Remember to save them at the end of a match.
folder.unsupported: Your browser cannot open a folder: choose the .replay files in {path}. Chrome and Edge can import the folder directly.
folder.denied: The browser did not give access to the folder.
folder.nothingNew: No new replay in the folder.
folder.found: {count, plural, one {# new replay} other {# new replays}} to send.
folder.error: The folder could not be read. Choose the files by hand.

upload.tooMany: {max} files at most per batch: {left, plural, one {# file was not sent} other {# files were not sent}}. Drop them next.

list.title: Files sent
list.partial: only the basic stats are available for now

reasons.too_large: file too large (20 MB at most)
reasons.not_a_replay: this file is not a replay
reasons.size_mismatch: the file received does not have the right size
reasons.read_failed: the browser could not read the file
reasons.too_many_files: too many files in this batch
reasons.rate_limited: too many requests, try again in a moment

upload.console: Console players cannot reach their replay files: the tool works on PC only for now.
